pool: 2 723 cropped emblem prints and 9 756 works from eight museums, 12 479 items
transfer_direction: trained on museums, tested on emblems -- the direction that works; the reverse fails because the emblem side is two collections of prints and does not generalise
reading: The mixture beats both pure representations at finding a cross-medium iconographic partner: median rank 409 at weights 0.25 to 0.5, against 500 for shapes alone and 1 143 for the visual encoder alone. On the narrow corpus the extremes bracketed the mixture; on the widened one the mixture dominates them, which is complementarity rather than trade-off and is the measurement that justifies separate channels. Weight 0.5 gives the best rank, 81% of the attainable transfer and a probe of 88.9% rather than 97.0%; weight 1.0 gives 92% of the transfer. Beyond that the probe and the rank both worsen for nothing.
